Optional contribution / client portfolio evidence

Reuse these fields in your existing project checkpoint or private client record; do not create a second tracker. Publish only a permitted, redacted summary. A merged contribution or published portfolio does not guarantee employment.

Client/project need and agreed scope: What is needed, for whom, included/excluded work, time limit and responsible reviewer?

My specific contribution: Identify your own work and credit collaborators; distinguish exercise, voluntary contribution and paid commission.

Accessibility requirements and checks: Record functional needs, devices, keyboard/reflow/assistive-technology checks, results and checks not run. Do not include medical records.

Tools and AI assistance: Name tools and assistance used, what you changed yourself and what you verified; AI is research to verify, not authority.

Sources and verification: Link original sources, date checked, claims confirmed, conflicts and unknowns. Reuse the source-verification record.

Review feedback and status: Record reviewer, date, feedback and evidence. Mark proposed, submitted, accepted and deployed separately; acceptance is not deployment.

Permission and redactions: Record who authorized portfolio display, permitted excerpts, attribution/licensing and required redactions. Keep private correspondence outside GitHub.

Artifact and unfinished work: Link the permitted artifact, exact version, limitations, failed checks, remaining work, next action and review date.
